QMines (ASX: QML) has completed the sale of its QDrilling subsidiary to Gas Field Services for $1.4 million in deferred payments. The transaction, part of the company’s strategic divestment plan, was announced by QMines and reported by multiple global news outlets aggregated through Google News. It reduces QMines’ drilling operations while freeing up capital for future exploration projects.
